mentions.name: SageNet
mentions.description: A voice-first AI coach that turns goals into structured, adaptive learning plans. After a 2-minute voice conversation, it generates a personalized 6-module roadmap with build-first projects, checks in by voice, analyzes reflections, and regenerates the plan as needed. Users can invite friends to a Support Squad for accountability.
mentions.problem: People don't want "infinite content" — they want structure and someone who remembers them.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building SageNet, a voice-first AI coach that turns your goals into structured, adaptive learning plans.
